description: Delete a connection by id. Flows and tools bound to it stop working until rebound. Runs 'pac connection delete' with the active pac auth profile. Mutates a live environment: requires confirm: true (a dry run otherwise).

background.description: Run in the background and return a jobId immediately, for a command that takes longer than the client will wait. Poll cs_job_status.

confirm.description: Required to actually perform a change in a live environment. Without it the tool returns a dry run.

cwd.description: Working directory for pac (for project commands: the solution project folder)

environment.description: Environment id or URL; default: the environment of the active pac auth profile

profile.description: pac auth profile to run as: the admin account for tenant commands. Defaults to CPS_ADMIN_PROFILE for admin commands and CPS_PAC_PROFILE otherwise, then the active profile. cs_init lists the profiles.

name: cs_delete_connection
title: Delete a connection
